verdict.line: You lose if she opens with double Lunge while Riposte is up and you throw your stun into it; you win if you bait that Riposte down first and then land Cryptic Gaze clean.

brief.thesis: Fiora's Q (Lunge) can be thrown twice in one window and her W (Riposte) punishes the exact kind of all-in Sion wants to make, so the entire lane is about sequencing, not raw stats — the 47.3% win rate over 148 games and Fiora's solo-kill edge both come from Sion players walking into a parry. Sion's W (Death's Caress) shield is strong enough to eat the poke if you don't get baited into trading auto-for-auto.

theirWindow.what: She will bait you with a Lunge or an auto to tempt a response. Do not throw Q (Cryptic Gaze) or extend with autos here — if she parries, she gets bonus AD and you've lost the exchange for nothing.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Riposte) just went on cooldown (6-10s depending on rank)
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Land Q (Cryptic Gaze) for the stun, pop W (Death's Caress) on top of her, and toggle E (Enrage) to trade autos — nothing she does here can parry it.

start.why: 52.8% win rate over 106 games and the highest pick rate (57.3%) because the passive sustain directly answers Fiora's poke-heavy Lunge trades.

boots.why: 49.6% win rate over 131 games, 73.2% pick — flattens her auto-attack and Lunge physical damage during the all-in windows.

core.why: Applies Grievous Wounds early to blunt her Duelist passive, which stacks and heals her the longer the fight runs.
Converts your E-stacked health into pressure so she can't just farm safely while you scale.
More Grievous Wounds uptime plus a shield that buys time for your own W (Death's Caress) to come back up.
This full path hits 80% win rate (small sample, 5 games) and caps her sustain for good once it's complete.

runes.keystoneWhy: 54% win rate at 26.2% pick — the per-tick heal and permanent health growth directly offset Fiora's poke-and-heal lane pattern.

summoners.why: 51.9% win rate at 81.7% pick — Teleport lets you play the lane patient (per the power curve, levels 3-10 favor her) and still reset top in time.

playing.title: Never Q into open Riposte
playing.detail: If her W (Riposte) is off cooldown, holding Cryptic Gaze is correct even if she's in range — a parried follow-up auto hands her free AD for the rest of the exchange.

playing.title: All-in only after her W is spent
playing.detail: Once Riposte is on cooldown, stun with Q, drop W (Death's Caress) on top of her, and toggle E (Enrage) to trade — this is the one window her kit has no answer for.

playing.title: Play passive before level 6
playing.detail: Her double-Lunge burst and lower Q cooldown make this her strongest solo-kill window; farm under turret range rather than contest trades.

playing.title: Don't duel into her E
playing.detail: Burst of Speed stacks move speed and attack speed every time she lands a hit or Lunge — disengage early rather than letting the fight run long under it.

playing.title: Rush Grievous Wounds
playing.detail: Bramble Vest into Thornmail directly cuts her Duelist passive heal, which is the stat that lets her win marginal trades.

playing.title: Group once you're ahead on items
playing.detail: Her R (Blade Waltz) deals less on repeat hits to the same target, so your stacked health matters more in teamfights than in the 1v1 lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner choices are pulled from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (148 games for this matchup); the sequencing and trade-window analysis is my own read of the kit.
